description: Sri Lanka Customs  -  Rates of Exchange effective from 10.02.2020 to 16.02.2020
categorisation: This gazette content is a Customs Notification that establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It exercises regulatory authority under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) to determine how customs calculations will be made, which falls under legal/regulatory matters. While it names an individual (K. A. Vimalenthirarajah, Acting Director General of Customs), this is in the context of exercising statutory powers rather than a personnel appointment or government restructuring. The content primarily concerns regulatory compliance requirements for customs calculations.
